title: Replace raw DateTime.now() with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() in DAO test fixture setup
why: TQ-6 requires hermetic tests with no wall-clock reliance. This exact suite's own shared helpers (seedProfile/seedTrack in test/helpers/drift_memory.dart) already route every timestamp through the injectable DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() specifically so the clock can eventually be pinned — but 30 sites across 8 files in this batch bypass it and call DateTime.now() directly for FK-filler timestamp columns. Today the values are unasserted so this is inert, but every raw call site is a future flake waiting to happen the first time a test asserts against 'inserted recently' or a snapshot equality, and none of these 30 sites are routed through any override point.
recommendation: Replace `DateTime.now()` with `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` (already available via the existing import chain, or add `import 'package:learning_tracker/core/utils/date_utils.dart';`) or a fixed literal `DateTime.utc(...)` at all 30 sites across the 8 listed files.
acceptance_criteria: All 30 listed DateTime.now() call sites replaced with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() or a fixed literal
Rule-0 checker: grep test/core/database/daos/**/*.dart for `DateTime.now()`; expect 0 hits
